name: Tebra (Kareo) Billing vs TherapyNotes
title: Tebra Billing vs TherapyNotes: Practice Management Comparison
description: Compare Tebra/Kareo Billing ($125/mo, multi-specialty) vs TherapyNotes ($49/mo + $0.14/claim, mental health-specific). Billing and EHR platforms for healthcare practices.

summary.bottom_line: Tebra (formerly Kareo) and TherapyNotes both offer EHR + billing, but for different audiences. TherapyNotes is mental health-specific ($49/mo + $0.14/claim), founded by a psychologist, with wisp note templates that auto-suggest CPT codes. Tebra is multi-specialty ($125/mo) with broader features including AI automation (Smart Staff) and patient engagement. Choose based on specialty focus and budget.

key_differences.specialty: Tebra: Multi-specialty | TherapyNotes: Mental health only
key_differences.founder: Tebra: Tech company | TherapyNotes: Licensed psychologist

sections.heading: Different Target Markets
sections.content: Tebra (formerly Kareo) serves independent practices across many specialties - primary care, family medicine, cardiology, dermatology, and more. TherapyNotes is built exclusively for mental health - therapists, psychologists, counselors, and psychiatrists. This focus means TherapyNotes has specialized features like wisp note templates that automatically suggest appropriate CPT codes, while Tebra has broader features like e-prescribing and Smart Staff AI.

sections.heading: Cost Comparison
sections.content: TherapyNotes is significantly cheaper: $49/mo for EHR + billing with $0.14 per claim (lowest in industry). Tebra charges $125/mo for billing alone or $250/mo for billing + EHR. However, TherapyNotes charges per claim while Tebra's claims are included. For a practice submitting 200 claims/month, TherapyNotes costs $77/mo total vs Tebra's $125+. TherapyNotes wins on pure cost.

sections.heading: Mental Health Specialization
sections.content: TherapyNotes was founded by a licensed psychologist who understood mental health workflow needs. The wisp note templates automatically suggest CPT codes based on session content. Tebra's Smart Staff AI automates routine administrative tasks but isn't mental health-specific. If you're a therapist, TherapyNotes' specialization matters; if you're multi-specialty or need e-prescribing, Tebra's breadth matters.

recommendations.when: You're a mental health practice wanting the lowest cost and therapy-specific features (wisp notes, CPT suggestions).
You're a multi-specialty practice or need e-prescribing capabilities.
Budget is primary concern - $49/mo + $0.14/claim is the most affordable option.
You want AI automation features (Smart Staff) or comprehensive patient engagement.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper - Tebra or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes is cheaper for most mental health practices. Base cost is $49/mo vs $125/mo, with claims at $0.14 each. Even at 200 claims/month, TherapyNotes costs ~$77 total vs Tebra's $125+.
Wisp notes are proprietary session note templates that automatically suggest appropriate CPT codes based on the content you enter. This helps ensure billing accuracy and reduces coding errors.
No. TherapyNotes doesn't include e-prescribing. If you need to prescribe medications, you'd need Tebra (with EHR module) or a separate e-prescribing solution.
Kareo merged with PatientPop in 2021 to form Tebra. The billing and practice management features continue under the Tebra brand with added patient acquisition tools from PatientPop.
